reviews.text: Game is rough. Frame drops and stuttering happens often. text is too small and pixelated to read. I think this has potential but I would wait on it.

*Update- still recommend just not if u wanna play on Steamdeck: the game's unsupported label for Steamdeck is 100% true. It hard locks when trying to load into a game when on the Steamdeck settings. Tried to tinker settings around to make it work and could not... but I could not get it to run at all, unlike my great experience playing the demo build. Dev confirmed in one of the steam discussion boards that the game is currently not stable on Steamdeck.* Been waiting for this one since I played 5 hours worth of the demo a couple weeks ago. I had initially seen the game's headlining feature, the perspective/camera swap, and knew this was for me. It really is a game changer once you figure out when to use 3rd person and when to swap to top down view. As an example, the scary demon that plops down on the first map (the red marker on your map, you'll know the one) forces you to play in 3rd person to keep eyes on him as he hunts you across the map, running outside of where your top down view can see. Its freaking sweet and quite a spectacle fighting him the first time. As a fan of Vampire Survivors and Deep Rock Survivors, this game scratches a similar itch for me. I'm seeing lots of reviews about performance issues... I've played for 2 hours so far and the game runs well with no hiccups on my system using highest settings, attached pc specs for reference- additionally, while I've not tested this newly released EA build on SteamDeck yet, I can confirm the demo ran flawlessly(all 5 hours I played on my SD OLED model with pixel graphics mode enabled, no crashes or crazy frame dips). Looking forward to playing more and seeing what else the devs cook up (CO-OP would be SICK!)

不错不错，略微超过个人预期~！（超过预期的两个点是：有风格特色的美术画风+较不错的视觉输出效果，含第三人称表现） 最初是在2024年间，视频无意间关注到的这个游戏，预感不错，可上帝俯视角+第三人称切换的肉鸽刷子游戏，没想到时隔两年，终于出来了。（不是2026年5月15日邮箱收到这个愿望单游戏发售，差点遗忘了，哈哈哈） 目前初玩下来，因为略超预期，简评下几个挺不错的【优、缺点】和提供一点小小的【开荒经验】给想入坑的小伙伴们参考： 1.美术画风、风格特色不错，有自己独特的味道，且优化确实还过得去（非极致画质体验）。 2.有一定的局外成长养成和组合搭配，大致分为： 初始装备（无法得知怎么带出单局局内获取物，更像是局外购入，通过主要神器槽附加装备给予） 神器（插槽类装备，1个主4个次槽，可以理解为携带式芯片，增加额外词条、特效与属性加成） 被动养成（就是独立人物的永久属性提升，被动技能等......，每个人物有独立的派系和分支侧重。） 局内增益可以有：主动技能、装备品质，数值提升，【诅咒柱子】给的收益与诅咒buff（同时获得，算个小特色，要做取舍） 3.因为有个不大的局外小城镇（可理解为菜单），稍微增添了一点点沉浸感。 4.怪物种类还算丰富（技能、特效），纹理，画质也都还不错，加上给力的的词条注释（属性说明和明确的加点方向），让预期舒适度更高了些。 缺点也还是有的： 1.因为最低2星难度，新人不熟练开局要死几次摸索，这很正常，但建议游戏开始的首局（第一次玩的），给个图标【注释】的教程指导，不然放在【加载界面】随机温馨提示，开荒有点迷茫，和一头雾水的满小地图图标，头疼不已~！ （备注：5月22日补丁已做出教程改变，感谢努力的制作者） 2.游戏本身，自然也还存在内容的不足，就初略看下来，3个人物和不多的养成面板，体验尽头可能来的会比较快。肝精英怪币和其他币种肯定不是归宿，期待更多的玩法或养成内容。优化没感觉有较大问题（可能除了AI无人机群上限拉满后，在第二张骷髅射手三星难度图，趁着夜色和背景，第三视角有轻微的卡顿外），但是还是建议模拟下更高画质参数可能性的进行优化。 3.不得不说，中文语种的时不时在一些选择升级项没汉化翻译，或者特殊道具无汉化，算一个小小的遗憾，建议查缺补漏，不要玩着玩着，时不时冒出英文了，头疼~！ 【开荒经验方面】——————主要是局内临时培养侧重（局外就靠刷和拼脸掉落好神器） 第一序列优先. 首先最重要一点，开局拿下黄色的免费装备/遗骸宝箱，大大提升生存空间的容错率。 第二序列优先. 建议优先考虑【商人】图标随机购入新式进阶武器装备（相对便宜，以及不用太拼脸与运气，有选择），再考虑地图上紫色宝箱（2500黑暗币纯运气宝箱） 第三序列优先. 有稳定喜好向【装备】与【随机技能或成长】后，保持稳定升级或进阶装备品质就好。 （备注：武器装备只有使用才能提升单局内的等级成长，从而更改配件和近战插槽符文/虚空石） 【随机技能】方向：个人推荐【机械系】>>>【奥术系】，因为前者大大降低战斗压力（背向/第三人称） 目前的随机技能偏好成长分三类：铁腕元帅【属性成长/附加词条功能】 机械神【飞刀，无人机，炮塔】 奥术法师系【雷、火、冰、毒爆】
和demo试玩时一样好玩，幸存者模式，能切换双视角，近战远程两种攻击方式，还有装备系统，感觉非常对味了。 感觉这游戏很有潜力，底层基本玩法非常扎实，在这个基础上塞各种内容会变得更好玩，期待后续更新

So far, I’ve finished the first map. There are three total, not counting the main hub area with the trainers and vendors. I’ve unlocked the Gunslinger class and most of its upgrades, along with the upgrades for the starting class. The game runs fine, but the frame rate is capped at 60. There’s no option to uncap it. The highest setting is monitor max, and my monitor goes up to 244Hz, but the game still won’t go past 60. Both the lowest and high graphics settings stay locked at 60 FPS. I don't know if the devs just tied everything to framerate. setting game to max drops frame rate every time enemy spawns to 10, CPU usage is almost always 30% and gpu is 100% Also, when using third‑person mode, aiming gets messed up if there’s anything directly behind your character. I can’t say the game is bad, but honestly, I’d rather just play Witchfire. Hopefully the game improves with future updates. Having projectile speed as a stat and especially having it show up as a possible level up reward is dumb. It doesn’t meaningfully change gameplay, so it shouldn’t be part of the upgrade pool. You should also be able to test action skills in the hub as soon as you unlock them from the trainer. I shouldn’t have to start a mission just to see what a new skill does. A lot of the action skills feel weak. Their base damage is way too low to be worth using epically when they lock you in place. The progression structure could use improvement. Instead of unlocking new zones or missions the way Witchfire does, maybe completing a mission could unlock extra rewards or modifiers. Running the same maps repeatedly gets repetitive fast. After doing the first map a few times, I realized it’s always the same. The runs always have same enemies, same bosses, same patterns. The only real variation comes from the upgrades you pick up and the objective locations. Minibosses and elites should come from a randomized pool instead of being the same ones every run. Weapon attachments also feel pointless; they have little to no noticeable impact. After beating a zone, you should be able to enable modifiers like other roguelikes do. That would give zones more replay value and keep runs from feeling stale. When spending currency to unlock a zone please add a buy outright option. Clicking buy 5x in a row is a really bad design decision. There is no legend or anything to explain what the map icons mean. Please add something so people can know what they are meant to do for some objectives.

[table] [tr] [th]游戏由SteamPY鉴赏家提供[/th] [/tr] [tr] [td]SteamPY鉴赏家[/td] [/tr] [tr] [td][h3]上SteamPY淘海量超低价游戏[/h3][/td] [/tr] [/table] 能够第一人称与第三人称随意切换的类幸存者，这虽然是游戏一大卖点，但是实际游玩起来并不会随意切换，甚至我都不会用第一人称来玩这个游戏。只要想到怪可能从你背后慢慢靠近你，你还如何敢得下正向面对敌人。所以除了是想感受下第一人称打丧尸，大部分时候还是以第三人称视角来玩这个游戏。作为3D游戏，游戏中也加入了地形高低效果，但是实际玩起来似乎并没有实际高低的影响，毕竟我都是第三人称视角在玩的。 作为一款类幸存者割草游戏，本身提供了两种攻击方式，武器近战和枪械射击，没有冷却随意切换，近战可提供范围伤害，射击可以在较远距离就对敌人进行射杀。需要注意的是，自动攻击并不会自动朝向敌人方向，移动方向和攻击方向是需要自行控制的，只有攻击方向上有敌人自动攻击才会生效，这跟很多类幸存者游戏还是不一样的，相比也是为了与第一人称视角下的自动攻击逻辑保持一致。击杀怪物获得经验，经验升级后可以选择各种技能和效果提升，技能种类是逐步解锁的，所能选择的并不多，有些能力比较弱，还是优先选清怪能力强的。地图上还有各种事件信标或图腾，诸如回血，强化武器，buff效果，箱子，以及相当有用的全部收集经验球，每个事件都有图标标记在小地图上，根据需要自行前往就好，地图虽然是开放的，但走到地图边缘会有明确的视觉反馈。 目前只有3张地图，难度不大，局内获得的装备和神器是可以携带出去的，返回主城可以选择所要携带的神器，局外养成有天赋可以提升，除了常规的被动属性提升外，还有主动技能可以选择，等于可以多一个主动释放的技能，像狂热这类的主动技能对于短时间提升战力还是有一些帮助的。 总体来说，由于尚处EA阶段，只有三个英雄可进行使用，但华丽的画质以及第一人称与第三人称的丝滑切换，还是颇具看点，玩起来还是挺爽的，只是目前的内容可能无法支持游玩太长时间，每个职业和地图都体验一遍，似乎也就没了继续游玩的动力了。
画风优秀，数值合理，双视角独特，但平视视角用不到，怪物是四面八方来的，而且速度很快，平视会被偷背。目前只有战士能玩，其他两个手感稀碎。职业平衡差，职业技能设计理念差。肉鸽元素局限性大，Bug众多，包括但不限于爆头击杀不统计，圣物莫名其妙消失，局内升武器品质太快会变成0伤害，扣血buff点太快会变0血游戏失败等等。游戏开发完成度极低，但颇具潜力，期待越来越好

刚开始觉得新鲜，玩了一阵之后发现，画虎不成反类犬，这武器的存在完全盖过了各种技能，那么其余技能的意义就是为了衬托武器？要么CD巨长，要么技能命中前已经被砍死或射死。 所谓的自动攻击更是不堪入目了，小怪都懂的提前量，居然没给自动攻击加上。 玩法单一，内容稀缺，物品栏页面好像都没做好。 怪物稀稀拉拉的，场景还有高低差，各种粗糙的障碍物。 目前不值这个价，该死的抢先体验，我是恨透了这种运营模式。都是抢险体验，为什么就不能稍微打磨一下再发行？说真的发行前自己都不玩一下的嘛？这作品自己玩着满意吗？ （说句实在话，是恨透了拿抢先体验当理由来发行的游戏商，感觉我们不是消费者而是Tom的小白鼠，还是那种花钱给别人当小白鼠的）。

平衡炸裂，骑士有盾又硬伤害又高，枪手就是个废物，法师也是个废物，远程伤害的职业都跟瘫痪了一样，枪手进去65的近战伤害远程伤害15？枪手技能树被动都是垃圾，一堆主动技能有什么用，局内只能用1个，主动也没有伤害技能还不给数值，就因为枪手是远程？真的傻逼设计。骑士的技能树等级加上去起码血量、近战伤害、近战攻速。 神器也是个傻逼设计，第一次见到有固定值的局外神器，固定值我刷钩子呢？ 我在哪里能看到诅咒武器击杀数和诅咒剩余时间呢？这不是搞笑吗，一碰就死还不知道剩余几个敌人没杀 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 2026.5.24 最后一张图的雪人boss过了，重新评价一下，这游戏简直就是工业垃圾。 属性词条基本没用，不如去强化武器的攻击力，一把+3的白板巨剑能把近战攻击力提升到800+，+2的双倍冰伤、+30近战冰伤的巨剑只有500+攻击力，伤害天差地别。 连续升级了2次控制属性后，无人机的伤害从每发9变成了10，这属性加成就是个笑话。 几乎所有的吸血和回血都不生效，暂时只发现一个回血会生效，击杀精英回复5%血量，只有这个会生效。近战攻击吸取1%最大生命值、近战暴击回复1%、击杀敌人5%几率回1血，武器上的5%生命吸取都不生效。目前已知的有效回血的办法是骑士最下面中间的技能泰坦之力，开了之后会提升最大生命值，效果结束就会把提升的最大生命值部分保留。 所有飞行怪都是粪，骑士的解决办法只有跑到脚底下瞎几把砍，枪手和法师无解，因为你根本活不到那个时候。 难度越高局内掉落越奇葩，第一张图随便能掉3-4个近战武器符文，最后一张图打完了只出现过1次符文。 远程武器的升级系统一眼就能看出是个半成品，正常来说应该是有很多配件可以局内自定义，实际上这玩意是武器升级后随机给的，有特殊配件会改变枪械性质，比如说喷子有独头弹枪口，纯负提升。把一枪喷死一片变成一枪打不中一个。 第三人称也是个笑话，当怪从四面八方包围过来的时候第三人称就是作死，且只适合远程。 总结一下，千万别买千万别买千万别买。这游戏主打一个忽悠，不要信那些推荐的up主，都是恰烂钱的。

[h1] ARTWORK IS NOT AI. Disregard the reviewer that has failed to detect real art [/h1] I can't speak for the voices cause they removed them (most likely those were AI; but who really cares) but as soon as I saw the artwork, I knew that it couldn't possibly be AI with the level of detail and unique design choices. And then the developers proved that it wasn't so there you go. The top reviewer has not only failed to realize what a fool they are but continues to defame a great indie game. The price of the game is very humble, and does not deserve to be defamed as AI slop. Truly sad that this is the world we live in now. I love this game so far. Hard as hell and plenty to build on. And there is definitely a lot to work on here so in case the devs see this, here are the main gripes: 1. Shields are useless, and should be replaced with lore-specific "OH SH!T" gadgets. The game heavily leans into dodging, and the shield is so clunky/slow to use. I literally never use it because I die immediately when I try to make a shield focused build. 2. The alien weapons are awesome but will 100% end your run because the curses are just so ridiculous. Literally picking up one of these will result in automatic death. Not fun. 3. Ranged weapons are too good and need to be tempered with ammo pickups and upgrades. You don't even need to build around ranged weapons, they will get attachments and upgrades the more you use them. As opposed to melee where you need to get specific level-ups and runes to make them effective. 4. Top-down view has a distinct advantage so the aim mechanic (only useful in 3rd person mode) needs to be buffed to reduce bloom and maybe increase crit damage. And that's it. Otherwise the game is awesome. I plan on changing my review when the devs update the game unlike the finook that calls this "AI slop" after playing for 13 minutes. Their review should be removed because it literally hurts the sales of this game. Absolutely shameful, especially after the devs went out of their way to address it and prove otherwise.

最近一直在肝这款游戏，玩法体验直接拉满。群怪扎堆就用俯视角大范围清场，单挑精英和 BOSS 切第三人称近战瞄准，两种模式来回切换特别有意思。 游戏不是那种纯挂机玩法，全程手动操作，近战挥砍、射击、闪避手感都挺扎实，重复游玩性很不错，我喜欢一个游戏多玩儿几遍，就是为了体验不同的打法产生不同的乐趣。风格上这种暗黑的风格我比较喜欢，就是以后建模可以再精细一些。 目前普通难度打起来还可以，感觉高难度下打起来有点吃力，再有就是新手引导也做得比较简单，以后要是能出个新手攻略之类的就更好了。 抛开这些小瑕疵，整体玩着很上头，可以入手试试，也期待官方后续更新补齐内容、优化细节。

虽然游玩不到20小时，可感觉已经没什么新内容可以体验了，干脆就直接评论好了。这游戏的模式类似《血腥大地》，一张地图在Boss死前无限出怪，只不过不像血腥大地是从外面向中间集中，这游戏怪是直接在玩家周围从地底爬出来的，所以倒也不限制玩家行动。这游戏可以刷两波宝箱，防具基本都在宝箱出，简单模式防具有抗性，困难模式防具好像就不带抗性了。武器不带石头就是默认装备，带了改武器的石头就可以开场带上石头上说的武器。这游戏基本没啥回血的主动技能，要么被动技能百分之几的概率微量回血，要么带上吸血，暴击微量回血的石头，要么开箱子出击中会杀敌回1点血的符文石，要么花大钱买血，总之这游戏是没什么稳定回血手段的。战斗方式能够由第一视角到俯视角自由转换是这游戏的最大特点，而且能自动普攻也是加分项，只不过将3张地图和3个职业都体验完，几乎就没啥其他内容了，感觉都不如像《血腥大地》一样，将一张地图分为不同内容的多关。总体来说，还是值得20元的票价。

This game is pretty awesome! I got it on a whim since I've been in a roguelike kick the past few months. Oh my goodness this arguably is the best early access game I have played! There isn't a lot in terms of content, only three playable characters and a few relics might be pretty bare-bones, but this game has the potential to rival some of the crazy good rogues of today! If I can suggest anything, I'd like us to be able to collect different relics, weapons, more weapon attachments, and possibly armor to make other characters and builds a taaaad more viable. If anything, the loot aspect is on the *weaker side* of this game, I want us to have gear sets and harder difficulties to unlock more stuff! Great work devs! Be proud of your hard work!

God, I love this game. Yeah, it's janky. Yeah, it's incredibly unbalanced. Yeah, the steamdeck settings make it look like hot ass. Yeah, the pixel mode is a hilarious joke. But listen, you ride into battle astride a phantom train, and the ♥♥♥♥ you do from there only gets more badass. This is a Survivor-like where the combat actually feels good. It's blowing my freaking mind. The is the definition of a rough early access game. It needs content, more items, more skills, more options, more QoL features, and a few balance passes. But it's already very fun and very playable, especially on the Steam Deck. Where, yeah it looks like a butt, but it runs a solid frame rate even at maximum chaos. It's actually impressive.

Best way to describe this game would be if Diablo, Risk of Rain, and Borderlands had a secret 3 way love child. For being an EA title only like a month or so. There are some good bones here. More content is needed for sure but what is there is decent.(They also just recently added the void rift content which has been alot of fun!) That being said there is a bit of EA jank here and there, that's to be expected my only gripe and this will probably change in the future is balancing between weapon types. Seems like alot of builds are geared more twords Melee and this works for the knight. The other two characters seem to fall behind a little once it starts getting later game. The gunslinger can keep up decently if you max his passives, the mage however is pretty lackluster in comparison. She has nice cooldowns but alot her skills are kinda jank/hard to properly use. Also what's up with Molten Orb dealing 0 magma damage all the way to lvl 5? is that a UI bug cuz if not that seems a little silly. Although I have been using the starter staff even with the unique upgrades magic doesn't come anywhere close in DMG compared to melee/guns and I feel like some upgrades mess up the hitbox on enemies and the first upgrade to shoot more fire balls kinda sucks to aim at things in front of you considering it shoots out in a big V and is impossible to shoot things that aren't in murderhug distance. I had an easier time just ditching magic all together and using guns with the elemental procs she has...The mage char is not a mage, at the moment she kinda functions like a Siren from borderlands just...not as good. Overall despite my gripes it's a fun survival rpg/shooter with the cool ability to swap between top down and 3rd person cameras. Some builds (like melee) feel better in the diablo style where as it's 3rd person shooter mode all day for the gunslinger. Overall it's a breath of fresh air in a market heavily saturated in the Vampire survivors/megabonk style of games lately. It obviously needs some more time to cook but what the current gameplay loop provides is still ALOT of fun if your a fan of top down/extraction shooters. (Also pretty please add more characters, weapons, and skins. It's off to a great start but we need more weapons in which to murderlate the rift baddies!)
